COMMONWEALTH OF PENNSYLVANIA GOVERNOR'S OFFICE, HARRISBURG 17120
P. O. BOX 191
August 1, 1972
Re: 72 06 2 038
James G. Watt, Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation U. S. Department of Interior Washington, D.C. 20240
Dear Mr. Watt:
The Pennsylvania State Planning Board, also known as the Office of State Planning and Development, has received a copy of the draft environmental statement for Executive Order 11644 - use of offroad vehicles.
This Office does not wish to comment upon this statement.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this environmental statement.
Sincerely.
George Kasparek Assistant Director
Office of State Planning & Development
of Kingnarus
